rules.status: gone = not on the latest scan · new = only on the latest scan this week · rising / cooling = latest heat ≥ 5 points above / below its previous appearance · steady = otherwise
rules.attention: Attention 0–100 = 40% Wikipedia views (7 d, 8 editions; English × 0.5; log scale 100 → 0, 1,000,000 → 100) + 10% rise vs the week before (+200% = 100) + 15% days on India's most-read list + 20% best Google Trending-now heat this week + 15% a release or match within 14 days. No figure = '—'.
rules.market: now / this week: on the market's own state lists; universe: also titles in the market's main language or read ≥ 100 times in its Wikipedia edition in 7 days
rules.dedupe: one row per entity: Wikidata id › Wikipedia article › a name the registry, calendar or trend uses › a match's team pair
